authority_boundary: This compilation validates and summarizes Council records. It does not approve, merge, activate, ratify, or certify.
conditions: Reorder the rollout: baseline and Stage 1 simplification; glossary and schemas; governed-payload identity; hostile shadow mode; Article XI amendment and Human Steward disposition; then bounded enablement.
Namespace decision vocabularies and reserve activation and effective for institutional effect.
Publish versioned validators for authorization, payload, campaign, graph, edge, holds, checks, projections, execution, readback, compensation, supersession, and terminal records.
Specify deterministic closed identity for repositories, revisions, dependencies, generators, expected outputs, campaign, graph, signature, expiry, and nonce.
Use one idempotent lifecycle with atomic replay consumption and merge-time validation of checks, holds, reviews, exact base, exact head, and predecessor readback.

Deny automated activation, ratification, certification, disputed judgment, substantive policy, permission escalation, authority schedules, office powers, protected workflows, credentials, AETHER authority, and MATHCERT dispositions.
Use narrow short-lived credentials and fail-closed cross-repository saga semantics.
Define canonical custody, immutable lineage, supersession, retention, retrieval, reconciliation, migration, and recovery.
Predeclare zero-tolerance shadow safety gates, one or fewer Human Steward actions, zero manual SHA transfer or dispatch, and at least 70 percent median elapsed-time reduction.
Assign maintainers, incident route, cost ceiling, one-action kill switch, and maintenance-value reviews.
Complete the Article XI package and exact-candidate validation before any merge capability.
